text:
lucy-cust: Hey team, compliance check: our auditors require BYOK with HSM attestation + per-key usage deltas. We want to rotate KEK every 4 hours. Can Redwood do this in a POC and show expected latency hit?
mia-sales: short answer: yes, but need to validate in POC. We'll propose a 4-week PoC to prove latency, unwrap ops, and cost.
trent-se: technical notes: two recommended architectures for POC -
1) sidecar key-proxy: unwrapped KEK cached in-memory with strict TTL, HSM only used for wrap/unwarp at rotation; best latency for hot paths.
2) remote KMS-on-every-unwrap: call customer's CloudHSM each unwrap, easiest security posture but likely higher p50.
trent-se: sample sidecar env we can test:
```yaml
sidecar:
  cache_ttl: 45s
  max_unwrapped_keys: 6
  mem_lock: true
rotation:
  schedule: "0 */4 * * *" # rotate every 4 hrs
  enable_notifications: true
```
james-security: auditors need: HSM attestation doc (vendor cert), evidence of key provenance, and immutable per-op audit logs (unwrap/wrap, key_id, timestamp, actor). Also need to validate that sidecar can run in FIPS mode if required.
lucy-cust: For our workload we average 8k token requests/sec at peak, ~18ms target p50. How many unwraps/sec will that generate?
trent-se: depends on cache_ttl and model-level KV cache. Rough calc: if one unwrapped KEK covers many tokens (we unwrap per-request-id, not per-token), with cache_ttl=45s and steady QPS of 200 reqs/s -> ~4 unwraps/s assuming reuse. But if requests are sharded across many ephemeral principals, unwraps could spike. We'll instrument in POC.
mia-sales: pricing note: key-op egress + HSM calls billed separately. We'll run cost projection in SOW. If customer takes Dedicated plan we can cap some costs. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
trent-se: sample audit line we can emit to your SIEM (single-line json):
```json
{"ts":"2026-09-10T09:21:05Z","event":"unwrap","key_id":"cust/keystore/kek-2026-09","request_id":"req_9a8b","service":"redwood-inference","principal":"service/matchmaker","src_ip":"172.31.22.8"}
```
james-security: added: we'll provide canonical schema and optional signed attestations bundle (signed_manifest.tar.gz) for the POC. Also: rollover test plan - we will do forced rotations to ensure clients tolerate key churn.
lucy-cust: For auditors, can you provide a sample attestation file name/contents?
james-security: example attestation filename: cloudhsm_attest_cust-20260910.pdf ; includes serial, firmware version, cert chain, and timestamped signature. We'll attach to the SOW.
mia-sales: proposed POC timeline:
- Kickoff (day 0): exchange firewall rules, attestation requirements, SIEM ingest sample
- Day 3: deploy sidecar in staging + small perf run (p50/p95)
- Day 7: rotate every 4h for 72h (stress), collect unwrap ops, cost delta, errors
- Day 10: capture final attestation artifacts, deliver logs and SOW addendum
- Day 14: go/no-go review with auditors

mia-sales: action items: @trent-se to deliver perf harness + unwrap metric dashboard, @james-security to attach attestation sample + log schema, @lucy-cust to confirm expected peak QPS and any FIPS requirement.
infra-bot: deploy: key-proxy v0.9 staged to stg-1 at 2026-09-10T09:30:12Z :white_check_mark:
trent-se: I'll include a perf script that toggles cache_ttl from 15s->300s to show unwrap ops vs p50 impact. Also will test with rotation jitter to simulate real churn.
lucy-cust: thanks — if the POC proves sidecar + cache_ttl=45s meets 18ms p50 and auditors get attest + logs, we can sign SOW. appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
